subject: Support & Success Tooling: renewal strategy and vendor consolidation
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Support & Success Tooling: consolidation kickoff

Team —

We have three parallel vendor touchpoints this quarter (Intercom renewal in May, Zendesk contract review in April, Gainsight renewal in June). I want us to lock a single playbook for negotiating pricing + SOW alignment and evaluate whether we consolidate routing to a single platform or keep a best-of-breed stack. Primary goals: reduce subscription spend by >=20% year-over-year, preserve response SLA for high-tier customers, and minimize migration risk.

Quick asks for today:
- Marissa: can you pull the current MRR and seat/usage metrics for Intercom & Zendesk (by product tier) and the Gainsight contract consumables? (please include last 12 months)
- Ben: flag any operational risks (e.g., billing ties, data retention differences, integrations that are hard to replace)
- Tessa: schedule a 45-min vendor alignment call with Intercom + Zendesk reps next week and cc procurement.

I attached a draft consolidation checklist to guide negotiation. We will treat this as a procurement sprint: decide by April 15 whether to push for consolidation or renew independently with aggressive credits.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_CS-Renewal-Roadmap.docx]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support & Success Tooling: consolidation kickoff

Laura —

Attached are the numbers you asked for. High level notes below plus an attachment with a price/usage grid.

Highlights:
- Intercom: monthly active seats for support messaging have grown ~14% YoY; we are at a mix of Pro + Scale seats across product and success teams. Current ARR: $185k, forecasted usage spike in Q2 due to product launch.
- Zendesk: mostly used by CS Ops and Platform Support; ARR: $130k but includes chat plus enterprise add-ons (orchestration, advanced routing).
- Gainsight: renewal triggers in June; current committed spend: $210k (CS license + outcomes module). There is limited activity on Gainsight's journey automation from product teams.

See Intercom_PRICING_Q1.pdf and Gainsight_RENEWAL_BREAKDOWN.xlsx attached. I also pulled the contract evergreen clauses — Zendesk has an auto-renew with 60-day opt-out language; Intercom requires 90 days.

I scheduled a vendor sync for Tue 2027-03-30 10:00 PT (tentative) — Tessa will send invites.

- Marissa

[Attachment: Intercom_PRICING_Q1.pdf]
[Attachment: Gainsight_RENEWAL_BREAKDOWN.xlsx]

From: Anna Ruiz <anna@intercom.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: samir@procurement-services.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Intercom pricing + consolidation options

Hi Marissa/Laura —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sharing usage. Quick responses below and attached is an updated Q1 pricing workbook with a consolidation discount ladder. Short summary:

- If Redwood consolidates messaging & basic ticketing to Intercom (removing Zendesk for chat), we can offer up to a 22% contraction discount on ARR for a 12-month commitment and provide migration support credits.
- We can carve out an integrations credit for Gainsight (we already have native integrations) — would need to confirm the specific connectors used.
- SLA: 99.9% platform availability SLA offered at enterprise tier; we can push for a 30-day credit carve-out in the SOW for first-year migration incidents.

I included a brief SOW sketch and our proposed migration playbook. Happy to walk the team through it during the vendor sync next week.

Best,
Anna Ruiz
Enterprise Partnerships — Intercom
[Attachment: Intercom_PRICING_Q1.pdf (updated)]

From: Trevor Miles <trevor@zendesk.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support & Success Tooling: consolidation kickoff

Laura/Ben —

Appreciate the transparency. A few points from Zendesk side:
- We have flexibility on enterprise crediting for renewals if contract term is extended to 24 months or includes committed usage tiers. We typically offer higher uplift discounts if the customer commits across Support + Chat + Orchestration.
- Data export and migration tooling: Zendesk can provide an export bundle (attachments + ticket threads) but heavy custom integrations (webhook consumers or internal syncs) will be scoped as professional services.
- Contract note: we have the 60-day automatic renewal clause — we can agree to pause auto-renew if you provide a written intent to evaluate options 90 days prior; we’ll put that into a redlineable clause.

Attached: Zendesk_SOW_v3.docx (sample SOW).

Thanks,
Trevor Miles
Strategic Accounts — Zendesk
[Attachment: Zendesk_SOW_v3.docx]

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support & Success Tooling: consolidation kickoff

Team —

A couple of operational flags before we go deep on pricing negotiations:

1) Integrations: our product-facing webhooks and ticket-side enrichment rely on a custom middleware that both Zendesk and Intercom currently call. Migration will require ~3 weeks engineering time to validate schema parity and replay historical events. This is the main migration cost risk.

2) Reporting parity: Gainsight currently pulls support events directly from Zendesk to feed health scores. If we move ticketing to Intercom, Gainsight ingestion needs a connector update — Gainsight charges for custom ingestion mapping.

3) SLA tolerance: we cannot accept more than 15% degradation in response pipeline latency for enterprise accounts on peak hours. Any SOW needs to define measurement windows and rollback conditions.

Recommendation: split negotiations into two tracks — (A) commercial (pricing/credits/SOW), (B) technical (migration scope and timeline). Put a procurement hold timeline for April 20 to allow legal to review redlines and procurement to issue a PO.

Ben
Director, Support Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@procurement-services.com>

Cc: Anna Ruiz <anna@intercom.com>, Trevor Miles <trevor@zendesk.com>, gainsight-renewals@gainsight.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement timeline & next steps

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Procurement will support a two-track approach as Ben suggested. Proposed next steps from procurement side:

- 2027-03-30: Vendor sync (Intercom + Zendesk + Redwood) to walk comms and migration options.
- 2027-04-06: Procurement receives redlined SOW drafts from vendors. Vendors to provide final pricing grid with committed tiers.
- 2027-04-20: Redwood internal decision (consolidate vs. renew) and procurement to issue tentative PO for selected vendor(s).

Please confirm: when you send SOW redlines to procurement, include a clear list of deliverables, migration credits, and acceptance criteria for SLA credits. Also include the legal contact for contract turnaround (speed to signature will determine actual credit offers).

Samir Patel
Procurement Services (contracted)
samir@procurement-services.com
